meta.title: Admin user storeId null coerced to empty string in JWT strategy causes UUID crash in all products endpoints

content.tldr: Admin user has store_id = NULL in the database. JwtStrategy converted null to '' (empty string) via `?? ''`. Any products API call then passed '' as a UUID to PostgreSQL, crashing with: QueryFailedError: invalid input syntax for type uuid: "".
content.environment: backend (NestJS) — all products endpoints (POST /products, GET /products, GET /products/:id, PATCH /products/:id, PATCH /products/:id/deactivate). Reproducible by calling any products endpoint while authenticated as admin.
steps_to_reproduce: Login as admin@eam.local (store_id is NULL in DB).
Call GET /api/v1/products with a valid Bearer token.
Observe: 500 Internal Server Error — QueryFailedError: invalid input syntax for type uuid: ""
content.expected_behavior: Admin users without a store assignment receive HTTP 403 Forbidden with message 'Store assignment required to list products' instead of a 500 crash.
content.actual_behavior: JwtStrategy.validate() returned storeId: '' (empty string) for admin. ProductsService.findAll() passed '' directly to TypeORM WHERE clause. PostgreSQL attempted to cast '' to UUID and threw a fatal query error, resulting in an unhandled 500.
content.root_cause: backend/src/modules/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts line 40: `storeId: user.storeId ?? ''` coerces null to empty string. The empty string is an invalid UUID. ProductsService and StoresService had no null guard before passing storeId to repository queries.
content.fix_description:
Three-file fix:
1. current-user.decorator.ts — widened AuthUser.storeId type from `string` to `string | null`.
2. jwt.strategy.ts — removed `?? ''` fallback; storeId is now passed as-is (null preserved).
3. products.service.ts — added ForbiddenException guard at top of every public method (create, findAll, findOne, update, deactivate) before any DB query.
4. stores.service.ts — widened findMyStore(storeId) to accept `string | null`; throws ForbiddenException when null.
content.regression_risk: Low. The null guard is a pre-DB early-exit. All existing store-assigned users are unaffected (storeId is always a valid UUID for them).

audit.author: vibe-qa-general
audit.note: Bug surfaced during Sprint 2 testing: admin login succeeds but any products API call returns 500. Root cause: null storeId coerced to '' in jwt.strategy.ts.

audit.author: vibe-backend-nestjs
audit.note: Preserved null in JWT strategy, widened AuthUser type, added ForbiddenException guards in products and stores services. tsc --noEmit passes clean. Branch: fix/BUG-0004-admin-storeid-null-uuid-crash.
